name: Free Faces · Commit Mono

title.zh: Free Faces · 按风格挑字体

description.zh: 看Commit Mono大字试排、字号控件与原站入口。 由 Simon Foster 策展的字体目录，按 Cursive、Display、Monospace 等分类陈列字体，每款详情页有大字样张、分类、样式数与许可信息，并可跳转到原站获取字体。
description.en: A typeface directory curated by Simon Foster, organized into categories such as Cursive, Display, and Monospace; each entry shows a large specimen, classification, style count, and license, with an outbound link to get the typeface.

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Free Faces (https://www.freefaces.gallery/).
Technology stack: React, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript.
Component specification: 看Commit Mono大字试排、字号控件与原站入口。

Visual details from source observation: 我们进到首页，顶部导航列着分类，彩色底图上是大字标题，下面接着最新字体的试排。先点顶部的 Display 分类，一屏一款，像 Unique 这样的大字，风格一眼能对上。再点进 Commit Mono 的详情看大字试排和字号滑杆，下面写着分类、样式数和许可，每款不一样，用前先看那一行。
Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
